verdict.rationale: Greptile claims reviews with "complete understanding of your codebase" and lets you scope review settings, rules, and context to the directories each team owns, which implies monorepo-aware operation. It also generates sequence diagrams to parse complex changes. Nothing documents cross-repository review or coherent handling of changes spanning repos, and an older community report cites a 10MB repo-size limit that blocked large repos. Missing for 10: any documented multi-repo or cross-repo change review, explicit large-monorepo scale handling, and independent hands-on corroboration on large codebases.
